## Maintenance problem

Describe the build, dependency, packaging, CI, or repository workflow problem and
its observable effect on contributors or releases.

## Proposed change

Identify the configuration or tooling to change and the resulting workflow.
State relevant version, platform, or compatibility constraints.

## Acceptance criteria

Replace these prompts with the expected operational result and its checks:

- [ ] The affected build, install, or automation path completes successfully.
- [ ] Relevant supported workflows remain usable.
- [ ] Contributor instructions reflect changed setup or commands where needed.

## Validation and limitations

Describe the commands, CI results, or package checks needed to verify the change.
State unsupported platforms, untested dependency combinations, and external
services required. Include only sanitized output.
